# Chapter 6 — Physics Libraries

Source: https://natureofcode.com/physics-libraries/

Key concepts: Box2D / Matter.js style rigid-body physics, constraints, joints, collisions, world simulation vs custom force models.

Seeds:
- Physics libraries chapter integrates rigid-body engines for collisions and constraints.
- Joints and constraints link bodies; the library handles the integration.
- Useful when custom force models become too complex for collisions.
